metadata.question: Did the water in Lake Bosumtwi appear more green in December 2024 than in December 2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lake Bosumtwi, Ghana (approximately 6.5°N, 1.4°W) - Collections: Sentinel-2 (from 2015 onwards) or Landsat 8/9 - Dates: December 2015 and December 2024 - Need to measure "greenness" of water - likely using Green band reflectance or green-related indices 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want clear water observations - Need to ensure we're analyzing water pixels only (could use water mask or define lake geometry) 3. Logic: - Calculate mean green reflectance or green/blue ratio for both periods - Valid Zero: If green reflectance is legitimately 0 (unlikely but possible) - Null/Error (C3): If calculation returns None/NaN - Empty (C1): If no images found for either period - No Valid Pixels (C2): If cloud masking removes all pixels 4. Approach: - Use Sentinel-2 for both periods (launched June 2015, so December 2015 should have data) - If December 2015 has no Sentinel-2, fall back to Landsat 8 - Compare green band mean values or green ratio ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Lake Bosumtwi geometry const lakeBosumtwi = ee.Geometry.Point([−1.4124, 6.5022]).buffer(4000); // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Get Sentinel-2 data for December 2015 let col2015 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(lakeBosumtwi) .filterDate('2015-12-01', '2015-12-31') .map(maskS2Clouds); let size2015 = await col2015.size().getInfo(); console.log(`December 2015 Sentinel-2 Images: ${size2015}`); // If no Sentinel-2 data in Dec 2015, try Landsat 8 let green2015, count2015; if (size2015 === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8 for 2015...'); const colL8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeBosumtwi) .filterDate('2015-12-01', '2015-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const sizeL8 = await colL8.size().getInfo(); console.log(`December 2015 Landsat 8 Images: ${sizeL8}`); if (sizeL8 === 0) { console.log('No data for December 2015.'); console.log('C1'); return; } const img2015 = colL8.median().multiply(0.0000275).add(−0.2); green2015 = await img2015.select('SR_B3').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: lakeBosumtwi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B3').getInfo(); count2015 = await img2015.select('SR_B3').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeBosumtwi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B3').getInfo(); } else { const img2015 = col2015.median(); green2015 = await img2015.select('B3').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: lakeBosumtwi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3').getInfo(); count2015 = await img2015.select('B3').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeBosumtwi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3').getInfo(); } if (count2015 === 0 || count2015 === null) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2015 after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Get Sentinel-2 data for December 2024 const col2024 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeBosumtwi) .filterDate('2024-12-01', '2024-12-31') .map(maskS2Clouds); const size2024 = await col2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`December 2024 Sentinel-2 Images: ${size2024}`); if (size2024 === 0) { console.log('No data for December 2024.'); console.log('C1'); return; } const img2024 = col2024.median(); const green2024 = await img2024.select('B3').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: lakeBosumtwi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3').getInfo(); const count2024 = await img2024.select('B3').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeBosumtwi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B3').getInfo(); if (count2024 === 0 || count2024 === null) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2024 after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Validation and comparison console.log(`2015 Green (B3): ${green2015}, Pixels: ${count2015}`); console.log(`2024 Green (B3): ${green2024}, Pixels: ${count2024}`); if (green2015 === null || green2024 === null || isNaN(green2015) || isNaN(green2024)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (green2024 > green2015) { console.log('Water appeared MORE green in 2024.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Water did NOT appear more green in 2024.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
